title: Warm Creamy Japanese Red Bean Mochi
description: A traditional Japanese dessert featuring sweet red bean paste and creamy mochi, perfect for a romantic evening
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the water and mochi flour, whisking to avoid lumps.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and forms a sticky dough.
Remove the dough from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Knead the dough until it becomes pliable and easy to shape.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Place a small spoonful of red bean paste in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling, forming a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the mochi until they are golden brown on all sides.
Drizzle the maple syrup over the mochi and serve warm with a dollop of heavy cream.
